Q1: What is the root-cause evidence for the `tests-system-python` failure on run 45000954628 (24-shard matrix, `.github/workflows/ci.yml:4311-4330`)?
Choices:
A) Paste the failing shard index plus the failing test name(s) and assertion or traceback from that job's log into an `/answer` comment (RECOMMENDED)
B) It was a runner or infrastructure flake (no test assertion failed); treat it as no-code-fix and just re-run CI
C) Unknown; let planning investigate the code changes in PR #9923 and fix whatever `tests-system-python` would plausibly fail on (low confidence, may fix the wrong thing)
Q2: How should the `orchestrate-poll (0)` cancellation be handled?
Choices:
A) Confirm it hit the 20-minute job timeout: treat it as a CI time-budget problem and rebalance or speed up group 0 within the existing 5-group matrix, without raising `timeout-minutes` (RECOMMENDED)
B) It was cancelled by a superseding run or concurrency, or by a manual cancel; no fix needed for this job
C) It hid a real test failure or hang in group 0: provide the test name that hung or failed
Q3: Where should the fix land, since the #9920 changes already appear on the default branch?
Choices:
A) PR #9923 is still open: fix on its head branch `ai/issue-9920` so its CI goes green (RECOMMENDED)
B) PR #9923 is merged or closed and `main` shows the same failures: fix on `main` through a new PR
C) PR #9923 is merged or closed and `main` is green: close this triage issue as obsolete, no code change
